ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In the Cartesian coordinate system $xOy$, the linear function $y=-4x-2$ intersects the $y$-axis at point $C$ and intersects the line $AB: y=kx+2$ at point $D$, and the area of $\triangle ACD$ is $\frac{16}{7}$. Connect $BC$. What is the area of $\triangle BCD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Substituting the coordinates of point D into the equation of line $AB: y=kx+2$,\\
we get $-\frac{8}{7}k+2=\frac{18}{7}$,\\
$\therefore k=-\frac{1}{2}$,\\
$\therefore$ the equation of line $AB$ is $y=-\frac{1}{2}x+2$;\\
$\because$ B is the intersection point of line AB and the x-axis,\\
$\therefore$ the coordinates of point B are (4, 0),\\
$\therefore S_{\triangle ABC}=\frac{1}{2}AC\cdot OB=\frac{1}{2}\times4\times4=8$,\\
$\therefore$ the area of $\triangle BCD$ $=S_{\triangle ACD}+S_{\triangle ABC}=\frac{16}{7}+8=\boxed{\frac{72}{7}}$;

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are coordinate axes xOy; the vertical one is the y-axis, and the horizontal one is the x-axis. A relatively gentle descending straight line is labeled AB, passing through point A above the y-axis and intersecting the positive half-axis of the x-axis at B; another relatively steep descending straight line is y=-4x-2, intersecting the lower part of the y-axis at C, and intersecting AB on the left side of the y-axis at D. In the figure, A, D, and B are on the same straight line AB, and D is on the left side of the y-axis. Reasoning: Since y=-4x-2 intersects the y-axis, let x=0 to get C=(0,-2). The straight line AB is y=kx+2, so its y-intercept point is A=(0,2), therefore AC=2-(-2)=4. Given S△ACD=16/7, and AC is the vertical base, the horizontal distance from D to the y-axis is |x_D|, so (1/2)*4*|x_D|=16/7, giving |x_D|=8/7. Combining with D being on the left side of the y-axis in the figure, x_D=-8/7. Substitute x_D into y=-4x-2, obtaining y_D=-4*(-8/7)-2=32/7-14/7=18/7, so D=(-8/7,18/7). D is on AB: y=kx+2; substituting gives 18/7=k*(-8/7)+2, that is -8k/7+14/7=18/7, hence -8k=4, k=-1/2. Thus AB is y=-1/2 x+2. B is the intersection point of AB and the x-axis; let y=0 to get 0=-x/2+2, x=4, so B=(4,0), OB=4. The area of triangle ABC is (1/2)*AC*OB=(1/2)*4*4=8. Since in the figure A is on DB and after BC is connected, △BCD is formed by △ACD and △ABC put together, so S△BCD=16/7+8=72/7.
